'''Katerin''' is [[Aiel]] belonging to the ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]''.

== Appearance ==
Katerin is short and golden haired.

== Activities ==
[[Rand]] sends her to relay to the other ruler of the Nations, that he will meet with them at the center of the [[Field of Merrilor]] in an hour.

== Trivia ==
* Katerin is named for Catherine Walker, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
